question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 8.**
solution:
The correct answer is: natural

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper meaning of these given words. 
 
 
• "Natural" (adjective) means existing in nature; not made or caused by human beings.
 
• "Unnatural" (adjective) means different from what is normal or expected.
 
• "Nature" (noun) means all the plants, animals, etc. in the universe and all the things that happen in it that are not made or caused by people.
 
• "Natures" is the plural form of "Nature".
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "to get stunning images of the incredible animals in their spontaneous habitats."
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, 'natural' should be used because we use adjectives to describe nouns. Mostly adjectives are used in front of a noun.
 
 
• Beautiful house.
 
• Natural settings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Finland is a country of vast green forests, beautiful Baltic islands, windswept Arctic mountains and (1) countless __blue lakes. These pristine and picturesque landscapes (2) __provide __a habitat for many wild animals and birds including (3) *__magnificent __*bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans, as well as (4) __the __world’s rarest seals. Birdwatchers flock to Finland to find (5) *__species __*that are hard to spot anywhere else in Europe. Keen wildlife photographers __(6) also__ come here to enjoy excursions and facilities that enable (7) __them __to get spectacular shots of the amazing animals in their **(8) __natural __**settings. Some of the great places to preserve these (9) ________ include Finland’s forty national parks, which are open to (10) _______ all year round.*
